faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ZeroWaste
faq.teamHelp: Our team is happy to help you.

general.a1: ZeroWaste is a platform that connects customers with local restaurants, bakeries, cafes, and supermarkets to purchase surplus food at discounted prices — reducing food waste and saving money at the same time.
general.a2: Businesses list their surplus food as discounted offers on the platform. Customers browse available offers nearby, add items to their cart, and either pick them up or have them delivered.
general.q3: Is ZeroWaste available in my area?
general.a3: ZeroWaste currently operates in the Greater Cairo area, including Cairo, Giza, and Qalyubia governorates. We are continuously expanding to new areas.

orders.q1: Can I choose between pickup and delivery?
orders.a1: Yes! When placing an order, you can choose to pick it up directly from the restaurant or have it delivered to your location. Delivery is subject to a small fee.
orders.q2: How do I track my order?
orders.a2: After placing an order, a tracking strip will appear on the home page showing the real-time status of your order — from confirmation to delivery or pickup.
orders.a3: You can cancel your order before it is accepted by the vendor. Once the vendor starts preparing your order, cancellation may not be possible.
orders.q4: What if my order is cancelled by the vendor?
orders.a4: If the vendor cancels your order, you will be notified immediately and the order strip on your home page will reflect the cancellation.

payments.a1: We currently accept cash on delivery and cash on pickup. Card payment is also available for online transactions.
payments.q2: Are the prices final or are there extra fees?
payments.a2: The price shown includes the discounted offer price. A delivery fee may apply if you choose home delivery. No hidden charges.

accounts.q1: Do I need an account to browse offers?
accounts.a1: You can browse offers without an account. However, to place orders, add favorites, or leave reviews, you need to sign in.
accounts.q2: How do I update my profile information?
accounts.a2: Go to your profile page from the navigation bar and update your details including name, email, and password.
accounts.q3: How do I delete my account?
accounts.a3: You can delete your account from the profile settings page. Please note that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

sustainability.q1: How does ZeroWaste help the environment?
sustainability.a1: Every order on ZeroWaste rescues food that would otherwise go to waste, reducing CO₂ emissions and helping fight climate change. You can track your personal sustainability impact on your home page.
sustainability.q2: What is the Sustainability Impact section?
sustainability.a2: The Sustainability Impact section shows you how many meals you have rescued, how much CO₂ you have helped prevent, and how much money you have saved — all through your orders on ZeroWaste.

businesses.q1: How can my business join ZeroWaste?
businesses.a1: Register as a vendor on our platform, complete your business setup, and submit your documents for verification. Once approved, you can start listing your surplus food offers.
businesses.q2: What types of businesses can join?
businesses.a2: Restaurants, bakeries, cafes, supermarkets, hotels, and any food business with surplus food are welcome to join ZeroWaste.
businesses.q3: How do I manage my offers and orders?
businesses.a3: Through your vendor dashboard, you can add, edit, and manage your offers, track incoming orders, and view your sales reports and sustainability impact.
